ipcc_ar6.label: IPCC AR6 Climate Reference Regions
ipcc_ar6.description: Iturbide et al. (2020) reference regions (v4) used by the IPCC AR6 WGI report for regional climate reporting.
ipcc_ar6.attribution: Iturbide, M. et al. (2020), Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 12, 2959-2970. DOI: 10.5194/essd-12-2959-2020. Data: SantanderMetGroup/ATLAS (IPCC-WG1 Atlas), CC BY 4.0.

river_basins.label: Major River Basins
river_basins.description: 28 major river basins filtered from the World Bank major-river-basins-of-the-world data catalogue, as curated for IPCC WGII regional synthesis.
river_basins.attribution: World Bank major river basins of the world data catalogue, curated via SantanderMetGroup/ATLAS (IPCC-WG1 Atlas), CC BY 4.0.

ocean_basins.label: Tropical Cyclone Basins
ocean_basins.description: Simplified rectangular tropical cyclone basin boundaries matching the 7-basin convention used by NOAA IBTrACS (BASIN attribute).
ocean_basins.attribution: Boundary convention matches NOAA IBTrACS BASIN classification (public domain, U.S. Government work).
ocean_basins.license: Public domain (boundary convention only; not an official product)
